method: Full source images visually inspected before I2V

sources.finding: Visible independently curved fingers on keyboard; supported forearms, screen-directed gaze, ordinary facial texture. Keyboard markings not treated as exact UI.
Both hands on keyboard instead of requested trackpad. Do not animate this as a trackpad sample. New still must show unambiguous pad contact.
Side view gives visible contact, wrists and gaze. Screen is dark/reflective; no claim of UI correctness. Source will support a short typing pause.
Clear trackpad is empty; right hand again incorrectly on keys, and display dark. Switch source model with the same simple contact constraint.

Unambiguous two-finger pad contact, separate resting hand on desk, lit screen with unreadable document, gaze into display. Left hand operates pad instead of specified right: accept visible roles and match motion prompt, not verbal anatomy. Natural texture and supported posture.

Visible lit document, ordinary uneven skin and hair, screen-directed gaze, low curved fingers on keys, supported wrists/forearms. Separate man identity accepted as independent sample. UI is illustrative generated content, not an exact product screen.
